messages.subject: fiml error
parts:
Hi Yves,

I am trying to use lavaan to model a factor with 20 indicators on ~36,000 cases. There is missingness in the data which I wanted to account for.

The model is a simple factor model, with the first indicator fixed at 1, with mean and variance of the factor estimated. I first ran the model with the following script:

> fit <- lavaan(model,data=pt36)

and have no issues. some cases are dropped from the analysis as expected. (32764 of 35669).

Then when including fiml requirements I get the following errors/warnings

> fit <- lavaan(model,data=pt36,missing="fiml")
Error in get(as.character(FUN), mode = "function", envir = envir) : 
  object 'g~~g' of mode 'function' was not found
In addition: Warning message:
In lav_data_full(data = data, group = group, group.label = group.label,  :
  lavaan WARNING: some cases are empty and will be removed:
  817 7184 7602 7632 12661 12744 17144 18129 18681 20710 22015 22136 24112 24333 26045 35350

Do you have any suggestions for remedying this error? I have been able to run the fiml model in OpenMx and it provides estimates in line with the first run above, with the complete set of cases (35669).

Thanks in advance.

-john

messages.author: c5bc2275c2e771c3
messages.subject: Re: fiml error
parts:
Answered my own issue here. I had the factor variance line stored in a variable named "var". This was enough to disrupt the program when it searched for the var function when running the estimate.moments.EM() function. All is right with the output when compared to other programs.

thanks,

-john

Hi Yves,

Here is the code pasted below. It just uses the variables vector as a set of variable names to drop into the syntax, so it could be V1-V20. Once I added in the commented rm() section it worked fine. Thanks for following up on this.

-john

variables <- colnames(pt36)[2:21]
lambda <- paste(variables, sep = "", collapse = "+")
res <- paste(variables, "~~", variables, sep = "", collapse = ";")
var <- paste("f1~~f1",sep="")
model <- paste("f1=~1*", lambda, "; ", res, "; ", var, "; f1~1;", sep = ""); #rm(var,res,lambda)

# get model parameters from complete dataset
fit <- lavaan(model, data = pt36, missing = "fiml")

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: fiml error
parts:
On 09/25/2014 09:22 AM, John Prindle wrote:
> var <- paste("f1~~f1",sep="")

Yes, this 'overrides' the var() function, and this gives trouble if
'var' is used (without parentheses), as in

var <- "f1 ~~ f1"
M <- matrix(rnorm(10*10), 10, 10)
apply(M, 1, var)

The solution is to replace 'var' by stats::var, as in

apply(M, 1, stats::var)

Now fixed in lavaan dev 0.5-17

Yves.
